facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/cobj:HSD_CObjEndCurrent
facts.value: The function passes no explicit data. Instead, it causes the display subsystem's accumulated texture-edge and translucent Z-list heads and counts to flow first into sorting and then into drawing. Display obtains the current HSD_CObj's viewing matrix as a fallback, combines it with each entry's optional viewing matrix, projection matrix, transparency class, and render mode, and finally clears the deferred-list nodes and counters.
facts.reason: Display list structure, transform fallback, and cleanup require displayfunc body review.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/cobj:HSD_CObjEndCurrent
facts.value: Finalizes drawing for the current camera pass by sorting the deferred Z-list work and displaying its texture-edge and translucent entries, after which the display subsystem releases and resets the deferred lists.
facts.reason: Sort/display calls are supported; list classes and release/reset details require displayfunc review.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/cobj:HSD_CObjEndCurrent
facts.value: On every call, it requests sorting before display and has no guard, branch, argument, return status, or current-camera reset of its own. The sort helper changes list order only when zsort_sorting is enabled. The display helper always walks the texture-edge list first and the translucent list second, then clears both lists and their backing deferred entries.
facts.reason: Local call order supported; sorting toggle and display walk order require displayfunc review.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/cobj:HSD_CObjGetEyeDistance
facts.value: Supplies the camera eye-to-target range used when fitting a shadow camera's projection to a viewing rectangle: perspective fitting derives the field of view from the range, while frustum fitting scales the rectangle by near-plane distance divided by that range.
facts.reason: Shadow projection caller mapping is outside assigned source.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/cobj:HSD_CObjGetViewingMtx
facts.value: Exposes the virtual camera's world-to-view transformation to rendering, collision, display, and other consumers in caller-owned matrix storage, allowing them to transform world-space data according to the camera's eye, viewing direction, and orientation.
facts.reason: Matrix-copy behavior supported; rendering/collision consumer enumeration requires caller review.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/cobj:HSD_CObjSetEyePosition
facts.value: The caller-supplied Vec3 flows through HSD_CObjGetEyePositionWObj to HSD_WObjSetPosition, which copies it into the eye WObj's position, sets that WObj's 0x2 dirty flag, and clears its 0x1 flag. HSD_CObjMtxIsDirty observes the eye WObj's dirty flag; viewing-matrix setup then reads the new eye position, combines it with the up vector and interest point in C_MTXLookAt, stores the result in cobj->view_mtx, and clears the consumed WObj dirty flags.
facts.reason: Setter delegation supported; WObj internal flag writes require foreign wobj code review.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/cobj:HSD_CObjSetEyePosition
facts.value: The operation asserts that cobj is non-null. For a valid camera it performs no local branching beyond that precondition and delegates the update to HSD_WObjSetPosition; that delegate is a no-op if either the eye WObj or position pointer is null, otherwise it copies the position and marks the WObj dirty for a later viewing-matrix refresh.
facts.reason: Local assertion/delegation supported; delegate null behavior requires foreign wobj code review.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/cobj:vec_normalize_check
facts.value: Supports virtual-camera orientation by validating and normalizing derived camera basis directions, including the left axis formed from the camera's up and eye vectors, while allowing the caller to substitute a stable axis when that direction is degenerate.
facts.reason: Foreign util.h definition confirms generic guarded normalization, but existing game mapping cites camera basis/fallback behavior beyond this assigned range. Shared header is not manifest-owned; defer mapping until caller and foreign-render review.
